meta.title: Create short version of the crypto_get_random_values tests for faster CI runs
meta.body_summary: Shorten CI runtime by conditionally testing only Uint8Array in crypto_get_random_values when on feature branches, using env vars to decide scope; claims reduction from ~20 min to <1 min.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot shortened CI test time by conditionally testing only Uint8Array on feature branches; style requests (function placement, explicit condition, const) addressed and merged.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 192 changed lines across 7 files, this is a small change by absolute volume. It fits a narrow-scope CI optimization PR that merged after two rounds of style-focused review.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer lastmjs requested to move the shouldRunShortTest function to the bottom of the file, use explicit `=== true` check, and avoid mutable `let` in favor of `const` with ternary.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce CI test time from ~20 minutes to less than 1 minute by only testing Uint8Array on feature branches.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple CI optimization with environment-based conditional testing, but required multiple style iterations (function placement, explicit equality, const vs let) which Copilot addressed iteratively. Success hinged on compliance with maintainer's coding conventions.

detection_detail.code_reading: lastmjs provided inline comments requesting function move to bottom, explicit `=== true` condition, and avoiding mutable `let`.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body gives instructions to set environment variables and run test; no benchmark or CI timing logs provided, but the logic is straightforward.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After each review, Copilot pushed commits addressing code style concerns, and no performance regressions were raised.

core_change_summary.description: In examples/stable/test/property/ic_api/crypto_get_random_values/test/tests.ts, added a shouldRunShortTest() function that checks environment variables (AZLE_IS_FEATURE_BRANCH_PR, etc.) to conditionally run tests only on Uint8Array when on feature branches, drastically reducing CI test time. Also touched other files (package-lock, copilot instructions, wasm templates, unrelated test files) due to maintenance commits.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The secondary changes include small updates to copilot instructions, wasm binaries, and unrelated test files committed by maintainer lastmjs after merging main, not related to the performance optimization.
change_trajectory: Implement short version with shouldRunShortTest and ternary operator.
After review: move function to bottom, add explicit `=== true` check.
Second review: replace ternary with mutable `let` and explicit if (reverted later).
Third review: revert to `const` with ternary while keeping explicit check.
Maintainer added merge commits and unrelated test tweaks; merged after LGTM.

review_signals.summary: Don't use mutations like `let`, use `const` and avoid mutation as before, but keep explicit conditional.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot reverted from `let`/if to `const`/ternary with explicit check in 467c129.

Final two LGTM reviews signaling approval.
Confirmed replacement of ternary with explicit if statement.
